info:
## 12-Zone Irrigation System (I1–I12)

Dashboard 2.0 + **node-red-contrib-sprinkler** program `Lawn`.

- **Hardware:** IrigationSystem (Tasmota) `POWER2`–`POWER5`, `POWER10`–`POWER17`; 24V `POWER1`; pump `pompaApa`.
- **Sprinkler zones:** `I1`–`I12` in sequence (zone-timer chain extended to I12).
- **UI groups:** **Area A** — I1 & I3–I10 (I2 excluded from this group); **I2** separate; **Area B** — I11 & I12. Each of A and B has **Start / Resume / Pause / Skip** (same `run-gate` + `timerctl out`).
